{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1hdm8M8KT6pW5F9igfs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Floyd-Warshall benchmark now runs distributed with MPI, and it always does. Output matches the original binary exactly, and the MPI build is about 3× faster than the original even on a single rank.\n\n**Changes** (only `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp` and `floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`; no new files, executable name unchanged):\n\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. No new dependencies.\n- **Data distribution:** block-row partition. Each rank allocates and initializes only its own rows of `dist` and `path`. Every rank walks the same `rand_r` sequence as before, so the initial matrix is identical.\n- **Algorithm:** in phase k, the owner of pivot row k broadcasts it. Row k doesn't change during phase k because `dist[k][k] == 0`, so the result is the same as the sequential algorithm.\n- **Overlap:** row k+1 is relaxed first and its `MPI_Ibcast` is posted before the rest of phase k runs. Pivot broadcasts are double-buffered.\n- **Kernel:** the relax loop is branchless, so `-O3 -march=native` can vectorize it.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. The full matrix is gathered to rank 0 only when `-r` or `-v` is given. Timing is the max across ranks, measured between a barrier and the compute phase.\n\n**Choices I made that you may want to change:**\n\n- Each rank regenerates the full random sequence (O(n²) per rank, untimed) instead of scattering it. This keeps initialization free of communication.\n- `path` is computed per rank but not gathered, because nothing outside the compute phase reads it.\n- The `Computation time` line is now measured from the slowest rank in seconds, and the GOPS line uses that same value, so the figure isn't truncated to whole milliseconds as before.\n\n**Verification:**\n\n- Compared `-r -v` output against a reference build of the original code. The result blocks and hashes match for n ∈ {0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 17, 64, 100, 257} at np ∈ {1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 16}. This includes uneven row splits and n < ranks.\n- Timing at n=2048 (`mpirun --bind-to core`), 1 → 32 ranks: 3002 → 1691 → 761 → 409 → 240 → 154 ms.\n- The original sequential binary takes 9394 ms at n=2048. The new code on one rank takes 3062 ms.\n- `-h` and unknown options behave as before. Errors exit with status 1 on all ranks.\n- Built with no warnings using the out-of-tree build in `/tmp`, so no artifacts were created in the repo.\n\n**Limitations:** the pivot-row broadcast uses `MPI_Ibcast` (MPI-3), which needs a reasonably modern MPI. Whether the broadcast actually overlaps compute depends on the MPI library's progress behavior; I didn't measure that on a real multi-node cluster. I only ran on a single 256-core machine with oversubscription, so cross-node scaling is untested."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":572,"cache_read_input_tokens":49647,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":572},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"537efe35-62ac-4aaf-8111-29db4a806794","uuid":"90ef7ef8-cf2b-4f78-87d8-6edc636dfed6","timestamp":"2026-10-14T07:02:49.283Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1hdkpVvZowzmKchsi7W"}
